tradition: Hermetic / Golden Dawn (Regardie, The Middle Pillar)
provenance: PEDAGOGICAL encoding of a published ritual; not initiatory instruction. Centers vibrated with god-names; light circulated crown→feet→crown.
note: Same body mesh as Trika layers. Frameworks are overlays — never mixed in one sitting.

trajectories.name: Descent of Light
trajectories.desc: White brilliance crown→feet, formulating each center with its god-name

trajectories.name: Circulation
trajectories.desc: Light rises feet→crown then rains crown→feet (cf. OM ascent + amṛta flood)
